Messages.Author: Chris Shorb & Tammy Martin
Messages.Body:
So I remember hearing that you can only bleed your prey,
unless you play a Kindred Spirits or Night Moves or other
card that expressly lets you bleed someone else besides your
prey. What I need is the citation of this either in the
Rules book, the DCI Rules, or in the REC (Rulings, Errata,
Clarifications). Now that our playgroup is finally playing
the tournament rules (except time limits), it means that I
need to be able to point to the page and say "Here it is!"

Thanks a bunch to anyone who responds. If done by e-mail,
that would be great.

Chris

mom

Revised Rulebook:

6.1.6. Action Card

Unless otherwise noted on the card, these actions are at zero stealth (see
Stealth and Intercept, sec. 6.2.2) and can be attempted by both vampires
and allies. If the action card describes a special version of a basic
action, then all the rules that apply to the basic action apply to the
action card, except as otherwise noted on the action card.

Example: If Lupo plays Computer Hacking (text: "Action. Bleed at
+1"), then all the normal rules of bleed actions (only being able
to target your prey, for example) apply, except that the bleed
amount is increased by one.
